title: DAAD University Winter Course Scholarships
summary: Support for an in-person German-language and cultural course in Germany.

mandatory.text: Age at least 18 and ongoing enrolment at a university in a programme-related country outside Germany.
German-university enrolment, including participating joint-degree enrolment, is excluded.
Undergraduates need two completed academic years; funding may be used only once.
Provide recent accepted German-language proof; the winter course specifies at least B1.

funding.description: Course and accommodation costs, EUR 475 once, insurance and country-specific travel allowance.
funding.duration: Four weeks; summer courses June–September, winter courses January–February.

application_rounds.notes: No confirmed application dates were established.

recurring_deadline_notes: Opens 1 June; deadline 31 July annually at 23:59, labelled Central European Time by the source. No year is inferred.

required_documents.text: Academic records and relevant degree or school certificate
